S.FORM: == Au-Ke-Lan == satabakiyay nu tukay u Au-Ke-Lan (kamu nu Hulam: 奧克蘭, Auckland) nu kitidaan itida i nutimulan a taypinyung timul nu sasulitan 37 tu' (37 00 S, (Auckland) 位於南太平洋南緯37度. u New Zealand itini i amisan u satabakiay nu tukayan, pangangan han "sipayapaya nu balunga a tukay" , tayaw u New Zealand nu kungan atu tatelungan nu patiyamay. . sayaway nu nipatideng tu suotu i New Zealand u Au-Ke-Lan , nika i cacay a malebut walu a lasubu enem a bataan idaw ku lima (1865) a mihecaan malimad taydan i amisan nu subal sakatimul tu a Uy-Lin-Dun . . aydaay a New Zealand u New Zealand saka limulakay a kakitidaan, u nantaypinyang a angangan nu kakididaan, u cacumudan nu tataydaan nu midang a kitidaan . . itini i tusa a malebut idaw ku enem (2006) a mihcaan u sakapahay nu kitakid nu kitidaan ani pipilian, Au-Ke-Lan u sakaliman nu sakapahay nu kitakitan.
S.PHON: == au-kə-r~ɾan == satabakijaj nu tukaj u au-kə-r~ɾan (kamu nu ħur~ɾam: ***, auʦkr~ɾand) nu kitidaan itida i nutimur~ɾan a tajpinjuŋ timur~ɾ nu sasur~ɾitan ** tuʔ~ʡ (** ** s, (auʦkr~ɾand) ***********. u nəw zəar~ɾand itini i amisan u satabakiaj nu tukajan, paŋaŋan ħan "sipajapaja nu bar~ɾuŋa a tukaj" , tajaw u nəw zəar~ɾand nu kuŋan atu tatər~ɾuŋan nu patijamaj. . sajawaj nu nipatidəŋ tu suotu i nəw zəar~ɾand u au-kə-r~ɾan , nika i ʦaʦaj a mar~ɾəbut war~ɾu a r~ɾasubu ənəm a bataan idaw ku r~ɾima (****) a miħəʦaan mar~ɾimad tajdan i amisan nu subar~ɾ sakatimur~ɾ tu a uj-r~ɾin-dun . . ajdaaj a nəw zəar~ɾand u nəw zəar~ɾand saka r~ɾimur~ɾakaj a kakitidaan, u nantajpinjaŋ a aŋaŋan nu kakididaan, u ʦaʦumudan nu tatajdaan nu midaŋ a kitidaan . . itini i tusa a mar~ɾəbut idaw ku ənəm (****) a miħʦaan u sakapaħaj nu kitakid nu kitidaan ani pipir~ɾian, au-kə-r~ɾan u sakar~ɾiman nu sakapaħaj nu kitakitan.
